project.name: osgi/domains/fabric
project.description: The fabric domain: what seedmatic READS of rke2lab. Where netplan owns the network underlay and dataplan the dataset layout, fabric owns their DELIVERY — it derives nothing of its own, it reads the two harvests the netplan and dataplan scions filed in the run and writes them into the fabric/plan linked worktree, the branch the other repos pin. Contract + bdd only, no -core: there is no synthesis to hold.
